taxonomy.note: Accepted by Kew/POWO; native in Texas. Historical synonyms include Poa trichodes, Eragrostis pilifera, and E. trichodes var. pilifera.

evidence: Hays County regional report lists sand lovegrass among natural grasses found in the Hays County study area.
UT Plant Resources Center has a Williamson County field treatment.
Kerr Wildlife Management Area vascular checklist includes Eragrostis trichodes.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Candidate seed mixes were not counted as native-county evidence.

morphology.look_here_first: Long hairs at the sheath throat/collar + glabrous culm nodes + a huge diffuse fine-branched panicle on a tall perennial bunchgrass.
diagnostic_traits: long hairs concentrated at sheath throat/collar

confusers.separator: Usually shorter with mostly smooth sheaths and a smaller airy panicle.
Hirsute across sheath surface with bearded panicle axils rather than collar-focused long hairs.

installation_guardrail: Do not install until explicit approval.
